companies.name: Forus
companies.description: Forus (formerly Tandem; withtandem.com redirects to forus.com) is a New York AI-powered healthcare platform that automates prescription access, including prior authorization and financial assistance, connecting doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma. Founded in 2023.
companies.excerpt: Sahir Jaggi, founder and CEO of Forus. The company recently went through a rebrand. Forus is a platform for automating access to medication. We started the company about three years ago. You're a Columbia University graduate and spent years developing strategy at Oscar Health. I joined Oscar Health in 2017. After spending five or six years at Oscar I made the leap to start Forus.

funding.excerpt: Jaggi founded Tandem, a prescription access service, to help patients get access to medicine. He's raised tens of millions of dollars from investors like General Catalyst and Thrive Capital, including a $7 million seed round, for AI-powered software that speeds up administrative tasks, including getting prior authorization and applying for drug affordability programs. Education: Bachelor of Arts/Science, Columbia University. Sahir Jaggi is on Forbes' 2025 30 Under 30 - Healthcare list.
Forus was founded in 2023 by Sahir Jaggi. The page lists $7M in 2023, $30M in 2024, and $123M in 2026.

He founded Tandem in early 2023. Forus adopted its current name in May, when Forus said it had raised more than $160 million across its seed, Series A and Series B financings. Jaggi later identified the Series B as a $125 million round. Adding the latest financing brings Forus's disclosed capital to at least $310 million.

Forus, a NYC-based AI network accelerating medicine, has raised $150 million in a Series C financing round led by Bain Capital Ventures at a $3 billion valuation. The round also saw participation from existing investors Thrive Capital, General Catalyst, Accel, Redpoint, BoxGroup, Pear VC, Vast Ventures, and SV Angel. Founded by Sahir Jaggi, Forus is building an AI network connecting doctors, pharmacies, payers, and biopharma companies.
